newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks close firm, selected utilities strong.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks close firm, selected utilities strong.

text.p: Madrid stocks ended firmer in relatively dull trade on Thursday, with strength in certain electric utilities bolstering the Ibex.
Trade is still characterised by a lack of final clients, and dealers continue to expect these to return after the 1997 budget is announced, towards the end of the month.
The general index added 0.64 points, 0.18 percent, to 358.03 and the Ibex rose 12.39 points, 0.3 percent, to 4,082.20.

Selected utilities expected to gain from pending regulatory changes to the sector moved up strongly. Iberdrola added 25 pesetas to 1,200 with around 4 million shares exchanged. The firm was also helped by the end of a large sell order.
Electricity distributor Sevillana added 25 pesetas to 1,065.
Eyes are now on Friday's Ibex futures expiry, although volatility is thought unlikely according to dealers.
Trade should keep the same fairly dull tone, at least ahead of the U.S. Federal Reserve meeting on September 24, where many expect a hike in key money rates.
